resume_instruction: Read README.md, run verify_literature.py, then execute round next_round. Append to SOURCES.csv; never renumber. Write ROUND_0N_FINDINGS.md; update this file; re-run the verifier; commit.

5.theme: CHANGE WHAT THE ROUND DOES: adjudicate the 24 mapped claims, do not add more sources
targets: PRIMARY DELIVERABLE: a claim-by-claim adjudication table (ADJUDICATION.csv + narrative) covering the 24 claims that have at least one source. For each: verdict (SUPPORTED / BOUNDED / CONTRADICTED / CONTEXT_ONLY), the specific source, the claim text as written, and a one-line required registry change if any. This is the deliverable the whole exercise was for; four rounds of sources have not yet produced one.
Do NOT pad. Search sweep only if a specific adjudication is blocked by a missing source. Decorative citations are the failure mode this inbox exists to prevent.

Revisit LEAN-CF-01 against LIT-0037: state concretely what a general rank-incidence formalization would look like and whether Mathlib already has the pieces (needs a search of Mathlib's matrix/incidence modules, not just papers).

Optional high-value: forward-citation pass from LIT-0018 / LIT-0028 to find the applied delay-plasticity literature that keyword search misses. Requires a citation-graph source; if unavailable, record as a permanent limitation rather than papering over it.

known_gaps: All retrievals are metadata- or abstract-level except where noted VERIFIED_FULL. No paywalled full text was opened; no numbered theorem is attributed to a source that was not read.
No forward-citation or citation-graph analysis. The field map is search-driven and therefore recall-limited.
The repository cites no external literature anywhere in its working tree. This inbox is the project's first bibliography.
